summary: Local Health and Wellness is promoting a series of September 2023 workshops on mindfulness and stress management, run with local healthcare providers. The note cites research linking chronic stress to disease and rising healthcare costs, then outlines sessions led by Dr. Mira Singh, Dr. Elaine Foster, Diane Marshall and Jessica Lee covering techniques, obstacles, success stories and workplace applications. The long-term aim is a more resilient community and a more sustainable healthcare system.
one_line: Local Health and Wellness announces September 2023 mindfulness and stress management workshops led by several experts, aiming to ease stress-related health burdens and build community resilience.
key_facts: Local Health and Wellness is spotlighting a series of workshops on mindfulness and stress management, run in conjunction with local healthcare providers.
Research indicates chronic stress contributes to heart disease, obesity, diabetes, depression, and anxiety.
Data attributed to the National Institute of Mental (Health) says stress-related health issues escalated healthcare expenses by close to 30% in the last year alone.
Dr. Mira Singh, a leading psychologist and stress management expert, will lead sessions scheduled for September 7th.
Dr. Singh says "Mindfulness isn't about silence; it's about self-awareness."
The workshops cover deep-breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation, guided imagery, and mindfulness meditation.
Dr. Singh's introductory session covers the biology, triggers, and physiological and psychological ramifications of stress; later sessions are hands-on practice.
Diane Marshall, a certified life coach, will lead a workshop on September 20th on integrating mindfulness into daily activities such as washing dishes or taking a shower.
Dr. Elaine Foster will hold a seminar on September 15th highlighting case studies of people who successfully used mindfulness and stress reduction.
Tom Matthews, a local teacher, says he was on the verge of burnout with insomnia and anxiety before mindfulness gave him "a whole new lease on life."
Corporate wellness coach Jessica Lee will host sessions starting September 25th on mindfulness in the workplace and reducing stress-related productivity loss.
Lee will share strategies for creating "stress-smart" workplaces, saying investing in employee mental well-being can improve morale, efficiency, and profitability.
Educational campaigns before the workshops aim to demystify mindfulness and make it accessible.
